entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return some shoes.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloFit XT-Pro Mountain Bike Shoes, delivered about 40 days ago. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
They're just not right. I've tried everything, but these cycling shoes keep giving me blisters on every ride.
I'm sorry to hear that's been your experience. That definitely sounds uncomfortable. Sometimes fit issues can be related to the placement of the cleats. Did you get a chance to adjust those at all?
Whatever. I don't want to fix them. I just want a refund.
I understand completely. Let me just confirm the return policy for this item. Please hold.
Okay, thanks for your patience. I've confirmed that your purchase is well within our 90-day return window. I can definitely process that return for you.

I've gone ahead and authorized the return. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account now. Just box up the shoes, apply the label, and you can drop them off at any postal service location. Once we receive and inspect the item, your full refund will be processed.
Great. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
